Audio to WAV Converter

Convert MP3, OGG, M4A or any decodable audio to a lossless 16-bit WAV.

🎵 Drop an audio file here or click to browse

Works with MP3, OGG, M4A/AAC, FLAC and anything else your browser can decode. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an audio file into the tool.
  2. Wait for it to decode.
  3. Click Download WAV to save the converted file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the conversion work?

The file is decoded to raw samples in your browser and re-encoded as 16-bit PCM WAV.

Which input formats work?

Any audio format your browser can decode: MP3, OGG, M4A/AAC, WAV, FLAC and more.

What format is the download?

A 16-bit PCM WAV at the source's sample rate and channel count.
